sentence_stem: If she had studied harder last year,
correct_completion: she would be working as an engineer now.
full_sentence: If she had studied harder last year, she would be working as an engineer now.
acceptable_variants: she would have a job as an engineer right now.
she would probably be an engineer today.

options.text: she will be working as an engineer tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: The result clause describes the present, so 'would be ... now' is needed. 'Will' with 'tomorrow' does not complete a mixed conditional.

options.text: she has studied engineering for years.
options.why_wrong: The stem sets up an unreal past condition, so the result must be a hypothetical present consequence, not a real present-perfect fact.

options.text: she would be working as an engineer now.
she worked as an engineer last year.
options.why_wrong: This states a real past event. It does not express the present result of an unreal past condition.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: third-conditional condition (had studied) with second-conditional result (would be working)
explanation: A mixed conditional links an unreal past condition to an unreal present result. Here 'had studied' sets up the past condition, and 'would be working ... now' gives its present consequence.
translation: لو درست بجد أكثر في العام الماضي، لكانت تعمل مهندسة الآن.
